verdict.rationale: Penpot's hosted instance serves a Swagger UI page ("MAIN API") backed by an auto-generated OpenAPI 3.0.0 document of 152 backend RPC paths, and live calls can be made after authenticating. That is a real, product-provided interactive reference. However, the help docs point users to the static generated reference rather than this UI, it is gated by a flag on self-hosted instances, and no curated runnable examples are documented. missing for 10: documented runnable request examples, discoverable linking of the interactive UI from official docs, default availability on self-hosted instances, hands-on or independent corroboration of try-it-out usability

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The hosted instance serves a Swagger UI page ("MAIN API") that loads the live OpenAPI document from /api/main/doc/openapi.json.
Penpot's hosted SaaS instance serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for the backend RPC API (152 paths, server design.penpot.app/api/main/methods).
